forbid.fix: Read the difference from the agent registry: add a fact to AgentFacts in @prismalens/providers src/agent/family.ts, set it in each agent's descriptor, and read it through HARNESS_REGISTRY in @prismalens/config/harness; never compare, switch on, list or key on an agent id
An agent's logo or letters is the mark in its descriptor under @prismalens/providers src/agent; read it from the provider registry, never keep an icon or a mark table beside it

Read a model's maker, a provider's name and its account pages from the harness registry (makerOf, providerOf, modelMaker, providerFacts in @prismalens/config/harness, from the models.dev snapshot); never keep a model, maker or provider table beside its use

boundaries.why: A screen lists providers from the API's providers.list and reads one member's facts from @prismalens/providers; adapters and the kit stay out of the bundle.
agent-host is shared with other products and stays a leaf; the providers package references its launch rows by id.
Descriptors import nothing built, so registry gen runs before any build; the API joins agent-host's launch row by id.
